exceptions.justification: The production entrypoints do not expose a terminal UI or pass attacker input to ncurses; containers run non-root, read-only, and without added capabilities while Debian prepares a fix.
Perl is not invoked by any API or worker entrypoint and no attacker-controlled regular expression reaches it; containers run non-root, read-only, and with no-new-privileges until Debian ships a fix.
The application does not enable a QUIC server and TLS is terminated at the controlled ingress; the runtime is additionally bounded by non-root, read-only, and no-new-privileges controls.
Production code never invokes the gzip executable for uploaded or attacker-controlled data; compression is handled inside reviewed Node paths and the container filesystem is read-only.
Perl and Archive::Tar are not invoked by API or worker entrypoints, so uploaded archives never reach the affected path; containers remain non-root, read-only, and no-new-privileges.
Perl and Archive::Tar are not invoked by API or worker entrypoints, so uploaded archives never reach the affected path; containers remain non-root, read-only, and no-new-privileges.
Perl IO::Compress is not invoked by application entrypoints and attacker-controlled glob patterns cannot reach it; containers run non-root, read-only, and without added capabilities.
The application does not call libacl mutation APIs, runs as an unprivileged user, and receives a read-only root filesystem with no added Linux capabilities.
Perl pack and unpack operations are not invoked by any production entrypoint and receive no attacker input; the runtime remains non-root, read-only, and no-new-privileges.
Perl Storable is not invoked by any production entrypoint and receives no attacker-controlled serialized input; the runtime remains non-root, read-only, and no-new-privileges.
The affected condition targets 32-bit Perl regular-expression compilation, while the image is amd64 and Perl is not invoked by production entrypoints; runtime controls remain fail-closed.
Perl Archive::Tar is not invoked by any production entrypoint and uploaded archives cannot reach it; containers run non-root, read-only, and with no-new-privileges.
